description: Machine-readable cross-repo ecosystem index. Companion to docs/ATLAS.md. INDEX ONLY: this file points to canonical owners; it does not own facts. For any per-domain fact, defer to ops/state/truth/sources.json (the truth spine). Manually maintained; keep thin.
composes: This atlas composes the existing orientation maps under docs/reference/project-index/ and the truth spine under ops/state/truth/. It adds only the cross-repo view (incl. private icn-infra/network-ops) + the consolidated boundary/claims guardrail + the NYCN-home reconciliation flag. It does not duplicate the family maps.
principle: ICN is the generic civic/institutional substrate; NYCN is the first institution package built on it; the meaning firewall keeps them apart. This index never restates volatile facts (status, phases, PR/sprint numbers, IPs) — it links them.

icn.role: Generic civic/institutional substrate: primitives, runtime, public substrate docs, architecture, ADRs/RFCs, state, truth spine. Public truth surface.

nycn.role: First institution ecosystem package / reference federation. Summit 2026 structure, committees, accessibility commitments, support-institution patterns, package manifest, private-overlay templates.

icn-infra.role: Org-level operating contracts, runbooks, cross-repo boundary contract, public-claims gates, source classification, host roles, service contracts.

network-ops.role: Concrete provider reality: personal/homelab topology, raw configs, secrets. Most-private layer.
must_not_contain: product or org truth (extraction requires the icn-infra scrub gate)

icn-learn.role: ICN Academy: role-based learning/onboarding. Teaches from canonical sources; is NOT canonical.
must_not_contain: canonical definitions of ICN (it consumes them)

icn-community-bridge.role: Discord->Matrix onboarding bridge. Scaffold/docs-first, not deployed. Outreach/routing.

homelab-inventory.role: Infra the homelab runs on; observed read-only from ops/. Provider/infra state.

readiness_vocab.no_readiness_laundering: Never restate a lower tier as a higher one: planned != done, rehearsed != live, private != public, fixture != real.

boundaries.meaning_firewall: ICN owns generic primitives + runtime; institution packages own local meaning; kernel/substrate stays meaning-blind. Local meanings must not be welded into substrate primitive types.
never_copy_across: NYCN private operating detail / Summit fixtures / private overlays / real PII -> never into public icn
icn-infra / network-ops operational values / host addresses / secrets -> never into public icn (scrub gate required)
ICN primitives -> never copied into nycn (NYCN depends, does not fork)
claims_requiring_gates: running Forge (Forgejo is a component, not the Forge)

read_first: live: git branch --show-current && gh pr list && gh run list

open_questions.summary: Two NYCN homes with divergent self-descriptions: in-core institutions/nycn/ calls itself the operational home (with conditions for a later split); the separate nycn repo calls the in-core tree a canonical test fixture it does not own.
open_questions.current_treatment: Treat the private nycn repo as the substantive package home and institutions/nycn/ as the in-core public-safe fixture/shape until an explicit decision lands.
